sections.appearance: Misaki has neck-length brown hair in a bob cut hairstyle and brown colored eyes. She usually wears a black mask on her mouth and has bandages around her neck and both arms. Many black piercings can be seen on her right ear. Halo ==== Her halo is a large red cross with multiple smaller red crosses evenly distributed throughout. Uniform ==== Misaki wears a black hoodie with red ropes, black ripped jeans, a black backpack, a white oversized jacket with multiple pockets and blue straps, and black boots with straps. Firearm ==== She uses a dark blue FIM-92 Stinger MANPADS. The school's motto is imprinted on the gripstock. She also has a black Ruger LCR revolver holstered in her boots as a secondary weapon.

sections.personality: Compared to the other Arius Squad members, Misaki's actions resemble the Squad's beliefs the most. Although the Squad believes that everything is in vain, their actions seem to contradict that. Misaki, however, suffers from severe depression between her frail body and the abuse she suffered during her time in Arius. Because of this, she has repeatedly cut herself and outright attempted suicide on multiple occasions, only being stopped by Saori and later Sensei. Her depression has eased by the time of Sheside Outside, though she remains distant and reserved. Appearance === Misaki has neck-length brown hair in a bob cut hairstyle and brown colored eyes.
